name: Praetor
equipped_with: A Praetor is equipped with: Frag grenades; Krak grenades.

option_groups.header: Burning Lore: the Praetor becomes a Psyker (see Burning Lore below) for +34 points.
Dark Oratory: the Praetor gains the Dark Oratory ability for +5 points.
Warsmith: the Praetor becomes a Warsmith (see Warsmith below) for +12 points.
option_groups.requires_legacy: Legacy of the Lord of Iron

abilities: Combat Tactics: The Praetor may assign a free Veteran ability to himself and a friendly unit at the start of the deployment. Both units must be able to gain the Veteran ability and it must be the same ability. It does not count against the limit on how many Veteran abilities a unit may have.
Praetor: A Praetor may use Combat Tactics a second time.

Master of the Legion: The army may take Legion Command Squads and Retinues, one for each Praetor. An army that has chosen an Archetype (Rite of War) must include at least one Praetor or Delegatus. (Draft wording B, to be confirmed by Eden.)

Burning Lore: The model is a Psyker: it can cast 1 power and deny 1 power per battle round. It knows Smite and the powers of the Anathemata discipline (see Psychic disciplines, Esoterist (Anathemata)). It knows no other powers. It has Terrifying(-1) (the Fear (1) of the book).

Dark Oratory: At the start of each of its activations, choose one friendly unit with the Mark of Word Bearers within 6" of this model: until the start of this model's next activation, the Leadership of all models of that unit is increased by 2.

Warsmith: Only with the Legacy of the Lord of Iron. The model gains the Blessing of the Omnissiah ability (see Techmarine) and the Master of Automata ability of the Praevian: it gains the Fearless ability while it is in a unit with Automata models, may join such a unit and may use "Blessing of the Omnissiah" on units with Automata models.
